headline.purpose: Page title in the header; the one large line on a page.

countdown-large.purpose: Countdown at the top of a task's detail sheet; unit beside it at 17px.

title.purpose: Task name heading a detail sheet; empty-state headings at 20px.

countdown.purpose: Right-aligned countdown in task and schedule rows; unit at 15px/500 secondary.

body.purpose: Task names in rows and form input values.

section-head.purpose: Sentence-case group headings above each list, secondary ink.

subhead.purpose: Locations, form labels, summary line, setting descriptions.

footnote.purpose: Hints, chart captions, settings footnotes, tertiary ink.

shadows.name: group-whisper
shadows.purpose: Task groups, inset groups, detail lists, empty states.

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: Selected segment in a segmented control.

shadows.name: desktop-frame
shadows.purpose: App frame on screens 840px and wider.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for presses, fades and colour changes (0.16-0.3s).

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Things settling into place: alert in (0.28s), toast in (0.34s), switch knob (0.24s).

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: Sheet sliding up from below; no overshoot.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Tab change: the page fades in, nothing slides.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce switches all motion off.

theming.mechanism: data-theme="dark" on :root, set from prefers-color-scheme or the Settings override; darkValue on each colorMeta entry is its dark counterpart.

components.description: The one main action of a sheet or empty state.

components.name: Secondary Button

narrative.overview:
Replacely is the calendar by the fridge, reduced to the one thing it is good at: crossing days off until a job comes due. It is laid out the way iOS lays out Settings: a plain page title, inset grouped lists of white rows on a warm grey ground, hairline separators, a bottom tab bar, and sheets that slide up from below. The calendar survives in two places only: the countdown, set as the largest whole unit ("3 months", "5 days", "Today", "2 days over"), and a strip of tiny day squares on the single most urgent job.

Density is low and the voice is soft. Everything is the system font. Hierarchy comes from size and a narrow range of weights, never from capitals, colour blocks or ornament. There is one accent, a muted brick, and it is spent sparingly: the add button, the active tab, primary actions, selected chips and anything overdue. Neutrals are warm (a hint of yellow in every grey) and contrast is gentle: ink is a soft near-black, the page is never pure white, and dark mode is warm charcoal rather than black.

This system replaced an earlier build with a printed red header band, a condensed self-hosted numeral face and all-caps headings. Those are retired; nothing here should bring them back.
keyCharacteristics: Apple grouped-list structure: plain page title, white inset groups (12px corners), hairline separators inset 16px.
System font only, with tabular numerals for every count.
Warm neutral palette with one muted brick accent; green only for done, amber only for due soon.
Countdowns in the largest whole unit; the day strip only on the most urgent job.
Flat at rest: a 1px whisper shadow under groups, real depth only for sheets, alerts and toasts.
Quiet motion: short eased fades and scale-on-press, no bounce, all of it switched off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Brick Rule
rules.body: Brick is the only accent, and it marks either the next thing to tap or something overdue. If a screen shows brick on more than a handful of elements, something is decorating.

rules.name: The Status Hue Rule
rules.body: Green means done, amber means due soon, brick means overdue. None of them is ever used for decoration, category colour or emphasis.

rules.name: The No Pure Extremes Rule
rules.body: Text is #2b2926, never #000; the page is #f4f3f0, never #fff. Pure white is a surface colour, not a background.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No text is uppercased, letter-spaced into a label, or set in a second face. Section heads are sentence case at 15px semibold.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (countdowns, counts, costs, chart values) uses tabular figures so the right edge of a list never jitters.

rules.name: The One Big Line Rule
rules.body: Each screen has one large line: the page title, or on a detail sheet the countdown. Nothing else goes above 21px.

rules.name: The Two Halves Rule
rules.body: The task list is always split into "This month" and "Later", each its own white group, with the most urgent job first. Do not add a third tier, a dashboard summary or metric tiles above them.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets more than the group whisper only if it floats above the page and can be dismissed. Rows, groups and buttons in the page stay flat.

dos: **Do** build every screen from white inset groups (12px) on Warm Ground (#f4f3f0) with 0.5px separators inset 16px.
**Do** use the system font for everything, with tabular figures for any number.
**Do** keep brick (#a8503c light, #df8f7b dark) for the next action and for overdue, and nothing else.
**Do** show countdowns in the largest whole unit ("3 months", "5 days", "Today", "2 days over").
**Do** keep the day strip to the single most urgent job and the detail sheet.
**Do** keep controls at 44px or larger, with a visible 2px brick focus outline.
**Do** keep motion to short eased fades and press-scales on the standard and settle curves, and let reduced motion switch it all off.
donts: **Don't** bring back the red header band, a coloured title bar, or any full-width colour block behind the title.
**Don't** add a second typeface, a condensed numeral face, or self-hosted fonts.
**Don't** uppercase or letter-space text into labels; headings stay sentence case.
**Don't** use saturated reds, mint, neon or gradients; the old calendar red (#c8281d) is retired.
**Don't** add decorative icons, icon tiles beside rows, status pills or extra badges; glyphs appear only where they are the control (tabs, add, search, swipe Done).
**Don't** add dashboard panels, metric tiles, progress rings or live seconds-ticking timers.
**Don't** use pure black text or a pure white page background.
**Don't** give in-page rows or groups more than the 1px group whisper shadow, and don't use bounce or overshoot easing.
